meta.title: Mythrill VTT — Target 7 Classes Machine-Readable Content Inventory & Audit

statusTerminology.proposed: Authored blueprint / proposal pending creator review and decision approval. NOT registered into production selectors.
statusTerminology.creator_approved: Creator-approved architectural decisions (e.g. 30-class target roster, Animist distinct, Inquisitor retired).
statusTerminology.implemented: Registered and fully functional in the live production codebase (23 selectable baseline classes).
statusTerminology.verified: Passed specific automated test suites (e.g. HUD component tests, regression suites).

honestFindings.activeRecordsAudit: Covenbane, Exorcist, and Dreadnaught have 48 discrete active records authored (2 core + 40 optional picks + 6 talent actives). Inscriptor, Witch Doctor, Bladedancer, and Totemist currently have core features, 6–8 sample progression spells, and 6 talent actives authored (missing 32–34 optional picks per class).
honestFindings.talentNodesAudit: All 7 classes have 3 talent trees specified with 50-point capacity and thematic clusters, but individual 3-rank JSON node objects (with numerical rank upgrades, prerequisite IDs, and grant mappings) are NOT yet expanded. They were previously presented as node summaries.
